headline: An Australian health-industry outlet says the new Heidi II AI assistant could find a market among hospitals that have no full electronic medical record system.
score_reason: Commentary on a market opportunity rather than a new event; no figures on adoption; lowered by 1.
importance_line: Australian hospitals without a full electronic record system and their clinicians are the audience, but this is one outlet's analysis and the claimed opportunity is untested.
summary: Health Services Daily argues that Heidi II, an AI tool whose agents can draft discharge summaries, assist with outpatient coding and navigate record screens, could suit Australian hospitals that run only digital chart viewers rather than a full electronic medical record. The piece is analysis, and it notes that hospital administrators are wary of the screen-navigating agents for governance and liability reasons.
notes: Commentary; the Heidi II launch details were not in the text we could read.
